question: Through what kind of conduct can one come to see the universe as arising from consciousness relish?
premises: Familiarity arises through conduct of rejecting accepting and disregarding.
Nondual conduct provides a basis for seeing without division.
The relish of consciousness is the source from which the universe appears.
inference: One who has grown familiar through nondual conduct sees the universe by virtue of the relish of consciousness.
uncertainties: The balance between rejection and acceptance remains open to practice.
plain_english: Having grown familiar with the conduct of rejecting, accepting, and disregarding, one sees the universe through nondual conduct and by the relish of consciousness.
